name: Venmo Open Graph social card by venmo.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a white canvas with a hard asymmetric split: the left column stacks a small bold 'Homepage' eyebrow over an oversized two-line headline in a heavy, tightly-tracked grotesque, while the right half is a large rounded-corner photo of two people at a tailgate. Two white pill-shaped payment chips with circular avatars float over the photo ('Wes paid', 'Leona for Game Day'), and a slice of brand-blue logo geometry bleeds in behind the subjects. Scale contrast between eyebrow, display headline and chip labels, plus the flat-white-to-warm-photo division, keeps the card legible even at feed-thumbnail size.
